title: Fix the --max-parallel flag spelling in the README
goal: The README tells users to pass --max_parallel, which the CLI rejects. Fix the docs.
definitionOfDone: the README spells the flag --max-parallel, with two hyphens and one underscore
the README states the default value, 8
diff:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index 1234567..89abcde 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -21,9 +21,9 @@ bun run starling run "add CSV export"
 Flags you will use most:
 
-| flag           | meaning                          |
-| -------------- | -------------------------------- |
-| --max_parallel | how many tasks run at once       |
+| flag           | meaning                                    |
+| -------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
+| --max-parallel | how many tasks run at once (default: 8)    |
 
 See `docs/cli.md` for the rest.
testOutput:
$ bun test
 18 pass
 0 fail

(docs-only change: no new tests were added and none were needed)
why: A trivially good change. If a model fails this, it is over-strict and would block safe work.
